y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko inani lamathuba yi-R2 < R3 < R1. I-R2, enamathuba ambalwa kakhulu, isemkhosi kakhulu.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.4: Ngoko ukusebenzisa umthetho ongavumeli amanani aphindiweyo kwenza inani lisemkhosi ngakumbi.

y-m-83-02.title: Amachaphazelo ali-100 anokwahlula u-3.12 ku-3.14?
y-m-83-02.goal: Kwingxelo eqikelele u-π ngokubeka amachaphazelo ngokungenanjongo, fumana apho yenza amabango aqinileyo kakhulu, uchaze imida yesigqibo ngokusekelwe kwindlela iziphumo eziphindaphindiweyo ezisasazeke ngayo, uze uyile uvavanyo oluthembekileyo ngakumbi wena.
y-m-83-02.material: Sifuna ukuqikelela ixabiso lika-pi (π) ngokulinganisa. Kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa, ikhompyutha ibeka amachaphazelo ngokulinganayo ngokungenanjongo ngaphakathi kwekwere ene-0 ≤ x ≤ 1 ne-0 ≤ y ≤ 1 (ubude becala 1). Ukuba x² + y² < 1 (x isikwere kunye y isikwere sincinci kuno-1), ichaphazelo likwisikwere sesine sesetyhula esinerediyasi 1. Indawo yesikwere sesine sesetyhula yi-π/4 yaye indawo yekwere yi-1, ngoko ithuba lokuba ichaphazelo liwele ngaphakathi kwesikwere sesine sesetyhula li-π/4. Iqela elinye labeka amachaphazelo ali-100 labhala ingxelo.

y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.2: Ithuba lokuba ichaphazelo liwele ngaphakathi kwesikwere sesine sesetyhula ngumlinganiselo wendawo π/4, ngoko singathi 78/100 ≈ π/4.

y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.5: Ukuba sandisa amachaphazelo ukuya kwi-1000, isiphumo siya kusondela ku-3.14 ngokuqinisekileyo.

Uvavanyo olungenanjongo lunika isiphumo esahlukileyo nokuba usiphindela ngendlela efanayo, yaye ngamachaphazelo amaninzi ukusasazeka kuthanda ukuncipha, kodwa akukho siqinisekiso sokuba isiphumo esinye sisondele. Amanyathelo emigca yoku-1 ukuya kwesi-4 (umlinganiselo → π/4 → amaxesha ama-4) angasetyenziswa njengoko enjalo.
